CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.haversine_km(lat1 numeric, lng1 numeric, lat2 numeric, lng2 numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when lat1 is null or lng1 is null or lat2 is null or lng2 is null then null
    else round((6371.0 * 2 * asin(least(1, sqrt(
        power(sin(radians((lat2-lat1)::double precision)/2),2) +
        cos(radians(lat1::double precision))*cos(radians(lat2::double precision)) *
        power(sin(radians((lng2-lng1)::double precision)/2),2)
      ))))::numeric, 2)
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.requeue_open_needs_for_worker_v5(p_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare v_need uuid; v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_account_id is null or not exists (
    select 1 from public.app_profiles p
     where p.account_id = p_account_id and p.kind = 'WORKER' and p.profile_status = 'ACTIVE') then
    return 0;
  end if;
  -- Same open set as the marketplace reader, the worker's own world only, never the worker's own tasks.
  -- Queueing is idempotent (enqueue_dispatch keeps the earlier run time), and the tick decides eligibility.
  for v_need in
    select n.id from public.needs n
     where n.status in ('PUBLISHED','SELECTION')
       and n.published_at is not null
       and n.remaining_search_closed_at is null
       and n.requester_account_id <> p_account_id
       and (n.response_deadline is null or n.response_deadline > statement_timestamp())
       and private.accounts_same_world(n.requester_account_id, p_account_id)
     order by n.published_at desc, n.id desc
     limit 200
  loop
    perform private.enqueue_dispatch(v_need, statement_timestamp());
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_admission_fingerprint_v1()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
SELECT md5(
 coalesce((SELECT string_agg(c.id::text||'/'||c.canonical_key||'/'||
      coalesce(c.parent_id::text,'ROOT')||'/'||c.state||'/'||c.catalog_version::text,'|' ORDER BY c.id::text)
      FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c),'')
 || '#'
 || coalesce((SELECT string_agg(m.category_id::text||'/'||m.execution_scope,'|' ORDER BY m.category_id::text,m.execution_scope)
      FROM private.work_taxonomy_category_modes m),'')
 || '#'
 || coalesce((SELECT string_agg(a.category_id::text||'/'||a.locale||'/'||a.normalized_key,'|' ORDER BY a.category_id::text,a.locale,a.normalized_key)
      FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a),'')
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_city text;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR octet_length(p_value::text)>2048
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_value->'required') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    OR p_value-array['required','shippingCountries','localExchange']<>'{}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN RETURN p_value='{"required":false}'::jsonb; END IF;
 IF NOT(p_value?'shippingCountries' OR p_value?'localExchange') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value?'shippingCountries' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'shippingCountries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   IF jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value)
       WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR x.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
     OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value))
         <>jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p_value?'localExchange' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'localExchange') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR NOT((p_value->'localExchange')?&array['countryCode','city'])
     OR (p_value->'localExchange')-array['countryCode','city']<>'{}'::jsonb
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,countryCode}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR p_value#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,city}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_city:=p_value#>>'{localExchange,city}';
   IF v_city IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(v_city,
      U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF')
      OR char_length(v_city) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
      OR v_city ~ ('['||chr(1)||'-'||chr(31)||chr(127)||'-'||chr(159)||'<>0-9]')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(
   translate(
     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(btrim(coalesce(p_value,''))),
       'ђ','dj'),'љ','lj'),'њ','nj'),'џ','dz'),'đ','dj'),'ß','ss'),
     'абвгдежзијклмнопрстћуфхцчшčćšž',
     'abvgdezzijklmnoprstcufhccsccsz'
   ),
   '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'
 ))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_requirement_tier_inherited_v1(p_req uuid, p_worker_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_req IS NULL OR p_worker_account_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
  WHERE c.id=p_req AND c.state<>'RETIRED'
 ) THEN RETURN 'NO_SAFE_MATCH'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
    AND w.category_id=p_req AND w.excluded
 ) THEN RETURN 'NO_SAFE_MATCH'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
    AND w.category_id=p_req AND NOT w.excluded
 ) THEN RETURN 'EXACT'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_relations r
    ON r.source_id=w.category_id AND r.target_id=p_req
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND NOT w.excluded
    AND r.relation='EQUIVALENT_VERIFIED' AND r.verification='VERIFIED'
    AND r.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND left(r.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
 ) THEN RETURN 'EQUIVALENT'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_relations r
    ON r.source_id=w.category_id AND r.target_id=p_req
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_related_acceptances a
    ON a.worker_account_id=w.worker_account_id
      AND a.source_category_id=w.category_id AND a.target_category_id=p_req
      AND a.relationship_version=r.version
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND NOT w.excluded
    AND w.allow_related_offers AND r.relation='CAPABILITY_CONFIRMED'
    AND r.verification='VERIFIED' AND r.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND left(r.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
 ) THEN RETURN 'RELATED_CONFIRMED'; END IF;

 -- Standard coverage tree walk with strict RELEVANCE CEILING (STOP LINE):
 -- Cannot walk up to Level 0 (Crown) or Level 1 (Macro Sectors).
 IF EXISTS (
  WITH RECURSIVE coverage(ancestor_id,visited,depth) AS (
    SELECT e.parent_category_id,
           ARRAY[e.child_category_id,e.parent_category_id]::uuid[],1
    FROM private.work_taxonomy_standard_coverage e
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c
      ON c.id=e.child_category_id AND c.parent_id=e.parent_category_id
         AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories p
      ON p.id=e.parent_category_id AND p.state='ESTABLISHED'
    WHERE e.child_category_id=p_req
      AND left(e.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
      -- RELEVANCE CEILING: Exclude Crown (parent_id IS NULL) and Sectors (parent is Crown)
      AND p.parent_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND p.parent_id <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
        JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes pm
          ON pm.category_id=p.id AND pm.execution_scope=cm.execution_scope
        WHERE cm.category_id=c.id
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.parent_category_id,
           coverage.visited || e.parent_category_id,coverage.depth+1
    FROM coverage
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_standard_coverage e
      ON e.child_category_id=coverage.ancestor_id
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c
      ON c.id=e.child_category_id AND c.parent_id=e.parent_category_id
        AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories p
      ON p.id=e.parent_category_id AND p.state='ESTABLISHED'
    WHERE coverage.depth<32
      AND left(e.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
      AND NOT e.parent_category_id=ANY(coverage.visited)
      -- RELEVANCE CEILING: Exclude Crown and Sectors from upward expansion
      AND p.parent_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND p.parent_id <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
        JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes pm
          ON pm.category_id=p.id AND pm.execution_scope=cm.execution_scope
        WHERE cm.category_id=c.id
      )
  )
  SELECT 1 FROM coverage path
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
    ON w.category_id=path.ancestor_id
    AND w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND NOT w.excluded
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities x
    WHERE x.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
      AND x.excluded AND x.category_id=ANY(path.visited)
  )
 ) THEN RETURN 'INHERITED_STANDARD'; END IF;

 RETURN 'NO_SAFE_MATCH';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_scope_eligible_v1(p_need_id uuid, p_worker_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_category uuid;v_revision integer;v_mode text;v_scope text;
BEGIN
 IF p_need_id IS NULL OR p_worker_account_id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT n.category_id,n.revision,n.execution_location_mode
  INTO v_category,v_revision,v_mode FROM public.needs n WHERE n.id=p_need_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_category IS NULL OR v_revision IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 v_scope:=CASE v_mode WHEN 'REMOTE' THEN 'REMOTE'
   WHEN 'STATIONARY' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   WHEN 'POINT_TO_POINT' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   WHEN 'MULTI_STOP' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   WHEN 'AREA_BASED' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   ELSE NULL END;
 IF v_scope IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Only requester's EXACT signed/current need revision may participate.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_need_snapshots s
  WHERE s.need_id=p_need_id AND s.need_revision=v_revision
    AND s.category_id=v_category AND s.reviewed_by_requester
    AND s.classification_state='CONFIRMED') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm ON cm.category_id=c.id
   WHERE c.id=v_category AND c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND cm.execution_scope=v_scope)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Confirmed worker GLOBAL execution choice is necessary, never sufficient.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
   WHERE choice.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
     AND v_scope=ANY(choice.modes) AND choice.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Require saved human consent for this precise worker+service+scope.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
    ON cap.worker_account_id=m.worker_account_id
   AND cap.category_id=m.category_id AND NOT cap.excluded
  JOIN private.worker_ai_saves saved
    ON saved.account_id=m.worker_account_id
   AND saved.review_id=m.source_review_id
   AND saved.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
  WHERE m.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND m.category_id=v_category
    AND m.execution_scope=v_scope AND m.active)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.work_kinds_v5(p_values text[])
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  closed constant text[] := array['SELIDBE_PREVOZ', 'FIZICKI_POSLOVI', 'MONTAZA_NAMESTAJA', 'SITNE_POPRAVKE', 'MOLERSKI_RADOVI', 'ELEKTRO', 'VODOINSTALATER', 'CISCENJE', 'PRANJE_PEGLANJE', 'BASTA_DVORISTE', 'DOSTAVA'];
  fold_from constant text :=
    chr(269)||chr(263)||chr(353)||chr(273)||chr(382)||chr(268)||chr(262)||chr(352)||
    chr(272)||chr(381)||chr(1040)||chr(1072)||chr(1041)||chr(1073)||chr(1042)||chr(1074)||
    chr(1043)||chr(1075)||chr(1044)||chr(1076)||chr(1026)||chr(1106)||chr(1045)||chr(1077)||
    chr(1046)||chr(1078)||chr(1047)||chr(1079)||chr(1048)||chr(1080)||chr(1032)||chr(1112)||
    chr(1050)||chr(1082)||chr(1051)||chr(1083)||chr(1052)||chr(1084)||chr(1053)||chr(1085)||
    chr(1054)||chr(1086)||chr(1055)||chr(1087)||chr(1056)||chr(1088)||chr(1057)||chr(1089)||
    chr(1058)||chr(1090)||chr(1035)||chr(1115)||chr(1059)||chr(1091)||chr(1060)||chr(1092)||
    chr(1061)||chr(1093)||chr(1062)||chr(1094)||chr(1063)||chr(1095)||chr(1064)||chr(1096);
  fold_to constant text := 'ccsdzccsdzaabbvvggddddeezzzziijjkkllmmnnoopprrssttccuuffhhccccss';
  folded text[];
begin
  -- EX-06 ex06b (S06). The hidden kinds of work (PKG-031b): a closed set of ELEVEN kinds recognised by word stems. The NAMES of the kinds are fixed HERE (a twelfth kind is an owner decision and
  -- needs a new body, never a data row); the STEMS are data: private.marketplace_config rows work_kind:<KIND> (a JSON array of literal lower-case substrings, at least 4 letters) and the
  -- classification version in the row work_kinds_head. Each value is folded first: lower case, Serbian Latin diacritics and the Serbian Cyrillic alphabet to plain Latin letters (the three
  -- Cyrillic digraph letters first), so one Latin stem serves every spelling. A kind is named when a stem occurs inside ONE value (never across two values). Text that names no kind returns
  -- nothing, so an unknown word never matches another unknown word. A registry that is not exactly the head row and the eleven kind rows is refused loudly, never half used; an extra
  -- row work_kind:<anything else> is ignored, so no data row can ever add a kind.
  if p_values is null or cardinality(p_values) = 0 then return '{}'::text[]; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from private.marketplace_config c
                 where c.key = 'work_kinds_head' and c.value ->> 'schema' = 'WORK_KINDS_HEAD_V1'
                   and c.value -> 'kinds' = to_jsonb(closed) and c.value ->> 'foldVersion' = 'SR_LATIN_CYRILLIC_V1')
     or (select count(*) from private.marketplace_config c
          where starts_with(c.key, 'work_kind:') and substr(c.key, 11) = any(closed)
            and c.value ->> 'schema' = 'WORK_KIND_V1' and c.value ->> 'kind' = substr(c.key, 11)
            and jsonb_typeof(c.value -> 'stems') = 'array') <> cardinality(closed) then
    raise exception 'WORK_KINDS_REGISTRY_INVALID' using errcode = '55000';
  end if;
  select coalesce(array_agg(lower(translate(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(btrim(v), chr(1033), 'lj'), chr(1113), 'lj'), chr(1034), 'nj'), chr(1114), 'nj'), chr(1039), 'dz'), chr(1119), 'dz'), fold_from, fold_to))), '{}'::text[]) into folded
    from unnest(p_values) v where v is not null;
  return coalesce((
    select array_agg(distinct r.kind order by r.kind)
      from (select substr(c.key, 11) as kind, c.value -> 'stems' as stems
              from private.marketplace_config c
             where starts_with(c.key, 'work_kind:') and substr(c.key, 11) = any(closed)) r
     cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(r.stems) s(stem)
     where length(s.stem) >= 4 and exists(select 1 from unnest(folded) t where strpos(t, s.stem) > 0)
  ), '{}'::text[]);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_initial(aid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare p public.app_profiles;
begin
 select * into p from public.app_profiles where account_id=aid and kind='WORKER';
 if found and p.profile_status not in ('DRAFT','ACTIVE') then raise exception 'WORKER_PROFILE_RESTRICTED' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 return jsonb_build_object('displayName',coalesce(p.display_name,''),'bio',coalesce(p.bio,''),
  'skills',coalesce(to_jsonb(p.skills),'[]'::jsonb),'tools',coalesce(to_jsonb(p.tools),'[]'::jsonb),
  'vehicles',coalesce(to_jsonb(p.vehicles),'[]'::jsonb),'licenses',coalesce(to_jsonb(p.licenses),'[]'::jsonb),
  'teamCapacity',coalesce(p.team_capacity,1),'workAreas',private.worker_saved_areas_v1(aid),
  'location',coalesce(private.worker_location_document(p.id)-array['profileId','accountId','revision'],
    jsonb_build_object('operatingCountryCode',null,'city','','radiusKm',15,'approximatePosition',null)),
  'availability',coalesce(private.worker_availability_document(p.id)-array['profileId','accountId','revision'],
    jsonb_build_object('timezone','Europe/Belgrade','availableNow',false,'rules','[]'::jsonb,'windows','[]'::jsonb)));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_ai_source_hash(aid uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(private.worker_ai_source(aid),'null'::jsonb)::text,'sha256'),'hex');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_availability_document(pid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
 SET "DateStyle" TO 'ISO, YMD'
AS $function$
  with material as (
    select jsonb_build_object('profileId',p.id,'accountId',p.account_id,
      'timezone',coalesce(pref.timezone,'Europe/Belgrade'),'availableNow',p.available_now,
      'rules',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',r.id,'weekdays',r.weekdays,'startTime',r.start_time::text,'endTime',r.end_time::text,
        'startsOn',r.starts_on::text,'endsOn',r.ends_on::text,'label',r.label,'active',r.active)
        order by r.id) from public.profile_availability_rules r where r.profile_id=p.id),'[]'::jsonb),
      'windows',coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id',w.id,'startsAt',to_char(w.starts_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
        'endsAt',to_char(w.ends_at,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'),
        'state',w.availability_state,'label',w.label) order by w.id)
        from public.profile_availability_windows w where w.profile_id=p.id),'[]'::jsonb)) as doc
    from public.app_profiles p left join public.worker_match_preferences pref on pref.worker_profile_id=p.id
    where p.id=pid and p.kind='WORKER'
  ) select doc||jsonb_build_object('revision',encode(extensions.digest(doc::text,'sha256'),'hex')) from material;
$function$

functions.signature: private.worker_calendar_conflict(uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_calendar_conflict(p_worker_profile_id uuid, p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone, p_exclude_agreement_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_worker_profile_id is null or p_starts_at is null or p_ends_at is null then false
    when p_starts_at >= p_ends_at then false
    else exists (
      select 1
      from private.worker_calendar_events e
      where e.worker_profile_id = p_worker_profile_id
        and e.state = 'BLOCKING'
        and (p_exclude_agreement_id is null or e.agreement_id <> p_exclude_agreement_id)
        and e.starts_at < p_ends_at
        and e.ends_at > p_starts_at
    )
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_location_document(pid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  with material as (
    select jsonb_build_object('profileId',p.id,'accountId',p.account_id,'operatingCountryCode',p.operating_country_code,'city',p.city,'radiusKm',p.radius_km,
      'approximatePosition',case when w.approximate_lat is not null and w.approximate_lng is not null then
        jsonb_build_object('latitude',w.approximate_lat,'longitude',w.approximate_lng) else null end) as doc
    from public.app_profiles p left join public.worker_match_preferences w on w.worker_profile_id=p.id where p.id=pid and p.kind='WORKER'
  ) select doc||jsonb_build_object('revision',encode(extensions.digest(doc::text,'sha256'),'hex')) from material;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_saved_areas_v1(aid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select r.envelope#>'{profile,workAreas}' from private.worker_ai_saves s
 join private.worker_ai_reviews r on r.id=s.review_id and r.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=aid order by s.created_at desc,s.review_id desc limit 1),'[]'::jsonb);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_need_covered_slots(p_need_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(sum(s.covered_slots), 0)::integer
    from public.need_selections s
   where s.need_id = p_need_id
     and s.status = 'SELECTED';
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_prepare_worker_ai_review_taxonomy(p_conversation_id uuid, p_expected_revision integer, p_activate boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare s private.worker_ai_sessions; r private.worker_ai_reviews; doc jsonb; missing jsonb:='[]'; expires timestamptz;
 v_source text;v_hints jsonb;v_modes jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;v_item jsonb;v_projection jsonb;
 v_saved private.worker_ai_saves;v_previous record;v_retained jsonb:='[]'::jsonb;v_count integer;v_category uuid;
begin
 if auth.uid() is null then raise exception 'AUTH_REQUIRED' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 perform private.closure_assert_open(auth.uid());
 select * into s from private.worker_ai_sessions where conversation_id=p_conversation_id and account_id=auth.uid() for update;
 if not found then raise exception 'WORKER_AI_DENIED' using errcode='42501'; end if;
 perform 1 from public.ai_conversations where id=p_conversation_id and status='OPEN' for update;
 if not found or s.safety in ('BLOCK','REVIEW') then raise exception 'WORKER_AI_NOT_EDITABLE' using errcode='55000'; end if;
 perform 1 from public.app_profiles where account_id=auth.uid() and kind='WORKER' for update;
 if s.revision is distinct from p_expected_revision or s.base_hash<>private.worker_ai_source_hash(auth.uid()) then raise exception 'WORKER_AI_STALE' using errcode='PT409'; end if;
 if p_activate is null or exists(select 1 from private.worker_ai_turns where conversation_id=p_conversation_id and state='PROCESSING') then raise exception 'WORKER_AI_TURN_PENDING' using errcode='55000'; end if;
 if p_activate then
  if length(s.candidate->>'displayName')<2 then missing:=missing||'"Ime"'::jsonb; end if;
  if length(s.candidate#>>'{location,city}')<2 then missing:=missing||'"Mesto rada"'::jsonb; end if;
  if jsonb_array_length(s.candidate->'skills')<1 then missing:=missing||'"Veštine"'::jsonb; end if;
 end if;
 if (s.candidate->'location')<> (private.worker_ai_initial(auth.uid())->'location')
  and (s.candidate#>'{location,operatingCountryCode}'='null'::jsonb or length(s.candidate#>>'{location,city}')<1)
 then missing:=missing||'"Država i mesto rada"'::jsonb; end if;
 if s.candidate->'tools' is distinct from private.worker_ai_initial(auth.uid())->'tools'
  or s.candidate->'vehicles' is distinct from private.worker_ai_initial(auth.uid())->'vehicles'
 then raise exception 'WORKER_AI_STALE' using errcode='PT409'; end if;
 perform private.normalize_worker_ai_availability(s.profile_id,s.account_id,s.candidate->'availability');
 select * into r from private.worker_ai_reviews where conversation_id=p_conversation_id and revision=s.revision
  and envelope->>'equipmentPolicy'='PRESERVE_LEGACY_NO_WRITE_V1'
  and base_hash=s.base_hash and envelope->'activate'=to_jsonb(p_activate) and expires_at>clock_timestamp()
  and s.revision>0 -- untouched sessions revalidate saved consent on every review
  and envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
  and envelope->>'classificationCatalogFingerprint'=private.taxonomy_admission_fingerprint_v1()
  order by created_at desc limit 1;
 if found then return r.envelope; end if;
 r.id:=extensions.gen_random_uuid(); expires:=clock_timestamp()+interval '15 minutes';
 doc:=jsonb_build_object('schemaVersion','WORKER_PROFILE_V1','reviewId',r.id,'conversationId',p_conversation_id,'accountId',auth.uid(),
  'profileId',s.profile_id,'revision',s.revision,'profile',s.candidate,'activate',p_activate,'missingRequired',missing,
  'canAccept',jsonb_array_length(missing)=0,'expiresAt',expires);
 -- Use only hints bound to the authenticated worker, this conversation, and
 -- the exact CURRENT candidate/revision/base_hash. They are suggestions only.
 v_source:=encode(extensions.digest(
   convert_to(s.candidate::text||'|'||s.revision::text||'|'||s.base_hash,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex');
 select h.proposals into v_hints from private.work_taxonomy_gemini_turn_hints_v1 h
 where h.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' and h.account_id=auth.uid()
   and h.conversation_id=p_conversation_id and h.source_fingerprint=v_source
   and h.catalog_version=(select catalog_version from private.work_taxonomy_control where singleton=true)
 order by h.created_at desc,h.id desc limit 1;
 if jsonb_typeof(v_hints)='array' then
   for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_hints) loop
     if v_item->>'mode' in ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
       and v_item->>'action' in ('REUSE_EXISTING','REUSE_ALIAS','EXTEND_MODE','CREATE_CHILD','CREATE_NEW_BRANCH') then
       v_modes:=v_modes||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
         'service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode'));
     end if;
   end loop;
 end if;

 -- A new untouched conversation may show the modes the owner already saved.
 -- This is continuity of an exact, current signed binding, not AI inference
 -- from a city, service wording, global flags, or a merely related category.
 if s.revision=0 and v_modes='[]'::jsonb
    and s.candidate=private.worker_ai_initial(auth.uid())
    and not exists(select 1 from private.worker_ai_turns where conversation_id=p_conversation_id)
    and not exists(select 1 from private.work_taxonomy_gemini_turn_hints_v1
      where account_id=auth.uid() and conversation_id=p_conversation_id)
 then
   select * into v_saved from private.worker_ai_saves saved
    where saved.account_id=auth.uid() and saved.receipt->>'profileId'=s.profile_id::text
    order by saved.created_at desc,saved.review_id desc limit 1;
   if found and v_saved.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb
      and v_saved.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
      and v_saved.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
      and not exists(select 1 from private.worker_ai_saves other
        where other.account_id=auth.uid() and other.receipt->>'profileId'=s.profile_id::text
          and other.created_at=v_saved.created_at and other.review_id<>v_saved.review_id)
   then
     -- The profile row is locked above. Lock the exact binding and current
     -- consent rows too, so a withdrawal cannot race the continuity read.
     perform 1 from private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
       where binding.owner_account_id=auth.uid() and binding.profile_id=s.profile_id
         and binding.request_key=v_saved.client_request_id for share;
     perform 1 from private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
       where choice.worker_profile_id=s.profile_id for share;
     perform 1 from private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 mode
       where mode.worker_account_id=auth.uid() for share;
     perform 1 from private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities capability
       where capability.worker_account_id=auth.uid() for share;
     select previous.*, binding.bound_at, batch.result as batch_result
       into v_previous
       from private.worker_ai_reviews previous
       join public.app_profiles profile on profile.id=s.profile_id
         and profile.account_id=auth.uid() and profile.kind='WORKER'
         and profile.profile_status='ACTIVE' and profile.updated_at<=v_saved.created_at
       join private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
         on binding.owner_account_id=auth.uid() and binding.profile_id=s.profile_id
        and binding.request_key=v_saved.client_request_id and binding.source_review_id=previous.id
       join private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1 batch
         on batch.owner_account_id=auth.uid() and batch.request_key=v_saved.client_request_id
        and batch.source_review_id=previous.id and batch.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
       join private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
         on choice.worker_profile_id=s.profile_id and choice.worker_account_id=auth.uid()
        and choice.consent_source='EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REVIEW'
        and choice.confirmed_at=binding.bound_at and choice.updated_at=binding.bound_at
       where previous.id=v_saved.review_id and previous.account_id=auth.uid()
         and previous.envelope->>'profileId'=s.profile_id::text
         and previous.envelope->'profile'=s.candidate
         and previous.envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
         and previous.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
         -- Expiration limits the original Save, not the durable saved consent.
         and previous.created_at<=v_saved.created_at and v_saved.created_at<=previous.expires_at
         and binding.bound_at>=v_saved.created_at
         and binding.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES'
         and binding.result->>'workerProfileId'=s.profile_id::text
         and batch.result->>'status'='COMMITTED'
         and batch.result->'requiresBinding'='true'::jsonb
         and batch.catalog_version=binding.catalog_version
         and batch.plans=previous.envelope->'classificationCandidates'
         and batch.review_digest=previous.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'
         and batch.review_digest=encode(extensions.digest(
           ((previous.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')||
             jsonb_build_object('baseHash',previous.base_hash))::text,'sha256'),'hex')
         and jsonb_typeof(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')='array'
         and jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
         and jsonb_array_length(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') between 1 and 24
         and jsonb_array_length(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')=jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)
         and jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)=jsonb_array_length(batch.result->'items')
         and binding.result->'serviceModeCount'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(batch.plans))
         and choice.modes = array(
           select distinct item->>'mode'
           from jsonb_array_elements(previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') item
           order by item->>'mode');
     if found then
       for v_item in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v_previous.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') loop
         select count(*),min(category.id::text)::uuid into v_count,v_category
         from jsonb_array_elements(v_previous.batch_result->'items') admitted(value)
         join private.work_taxonomy_categories category on category.id::text=admitted.value->>'categoryId'
         join private.work_taxonomy_category_modes scope on scope.category_id=category.id
           and scope.execution_scope=v_item->>'mode'
         join private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 mode
           on mode.worker_account_id=auth.uid() and mode.category_id=category.id
          and mode.execution_scope=scope.execution_scope and mode.active
          and mode.source_review_id=v_saved.review_id and mode.source_request_key=v_saved.client_request_id
          and mode.confirmed_at=v_previous.bound_at
         join private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities capability
           on capability.worker_account_id=auth.uid() and capability.category_id=category.id
          and not capability.excluded and capability.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED'
          and capability.confirmed_at=v_previous.bound_at and capability.updated_at<=v_previous.bound_at
         where admitted.value->>'service'=v_item->>'service'
           and admitted.value->>'mode'=v_item->>'mode'
           and v_item->>'mode' in ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
           and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(s.candidate->'skills') skill(value)
             where skill.value=to_jsonb(v_item->>'service'))
           and category.state='ESTABLISHED'
           and (category.canonical_key=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service')
             or exists(select 1 from private.work_taxonomy_aliases alias
               where alias.category_id=category.id
                 and alias.normalized_key=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_item->>'service')));
         if v_count<>1 then v_modes:='[]'::jsonb;v_retained:='[]'::jsonb;exit; end if;
         v_modes:=v_modes||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode'));
         v_retained:=v_retained||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
           'service',v_item->>'service','mode',v_item->>'mode','categoryId',v_category));
       end loop;
     end if;
   end if;
 end if;
 -- The independent helper requires ALL displayed services, exact established
 -- category+scope and current catalog. Unknown work stays pending.
 v_projection:=private.taxonomy_review_candidate_projection_v2(
   'WORKER_CAPABILITY',s.candidate->'skills',v_modes,auth.uid(),p_conversation_id);
 -- Exact projection must resolve to the same retained category in today's
 -- catalog. An alias that moved or became ambiguous cannot grant a new skill.
 if v_retained<>'[]'::jsonb and v_projection->>'status'='READY'
   and exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_projection->'classificationCandidates') projected(value)
     where not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(v_retained) retained(value)
       where retained.value->>'service'=projected.value->>'service'
         and retained.value->>'mode'=projected.value->>'mode'
         and retained.value->>'categoryId'=projected.value->>'categoryId'))
 then
   v_projection:=private.taxonomy_review_exact_projection_v1('WORKER_CAPABILITY',s.candidate->'skills','[]'::jsonb);
 end if;
 v_projection:=private.taxonomy_preserve_review_handoff_v1(v_projection,auth.uid(),p_conversation_id);
 doc:=doc||jsonb_build_object('classificationState',v_projection->>'status',
   'classificationCandidates',v_projection->'classificationCandidates',
   'reviewedServiceModes',v_projection->'reviewedServiceModes',
   'classificationCatalogVersion',v_projection->'classificationCatalogVersion',
   'classificationCatalogFingerprint',v_projection->'classificationCatalogFingerprint');
 -- Sign BEFORE storing or returning the owner-visible review.
 doc:=doc||jsonb_build_object('equipmentPolicy','PRESERVE_LEGACY_NO_WRITE_V1');
 doc:=doc||jsonb_build_object('displayedContentDigest',encode(extensions.digest((doc||jsonb_build_object('baseHash',s.base_hash))::text,'sha256'),'hex'));
 insert into private.worker_ai_reviews(id,account_id,conversation_id,revision,base_hash,envelope,expires_at)
 values(r.id,auth.uid(),p_conversation_id,s.revision,s.base_hash,doc,expires);
 return doc;
end $function$

functions.signature: public.rpc_submit_response(uuid,integer,uuid,integer,integer,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,text,text)
